safety_bugs.description: Broad except Exception: pass silently swallows all errors including lock failures and data corruption, preventing fault detection during critical operations.
safety_bugs.fix: Replace with specific exception handling and log/print error to trigger safety alerts.

safety_bugs.description: Log lists (cmd_vel_log, odom_log, etc.) grow indefinitely without size limits or periodic flushing, causing unbounded memory growth and potential OOM crash.
safety_bugs.fix: Add max length check: if len(self.cmd_vel_log) > MAX_SIZE: self.cmd_vel_log.pop(0)

safety_bugs.description: No explicit cleanup for ROS client or REST polling thread on shutdown, risking connection leaks and zombie background processes.
